name: @howells/husky
description: Standardised git hooks for Howells projects. Immutable pre-commit and pre-push configuration.

scripts.lint: howells-ox-check --config=oxlint.config.ts package.json bin hooks README.md oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: howells-ox-fix --config=oxlint.config.ts package.json bin hooks README.md oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts
scripts.format: howells-oxfmt --write package.json bin hooks README.md oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts README.md
